'''Tōsho Shrine''' (當所神社 / 当所神社) refers to Shinto shrines located in Japan.

* {{ill|Tōsho Shrine (Fujinomiya City)|ja|當所神社 (富士宮市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tōsho Shrine (Fujinomiya City)}} - Located in Kitayama, {{ill|Fujinomiya, Shizuoka|en|Fujinomiya, Shizuoka|qid=Q496072|lt=Fujinomiya City}}, {{ill|Shizuoka Prefecture|en|Shizuoka Prefecture|qid=Q131320|lt=Shizuoka Prefecture}}.
* {{ill|Tōsho Shrine (Anan City)|ja|當所神社 (阿南市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tōsho Shrine (Anan City)}} - Located in {{ill|Ishimachō|ja|伊島町 (阿南市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ishima Town (Anan City)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q28686952}}, {{ill|Anan, Tokushima|en|Anan, Tokushima|qid=Q485583|lt=Anan City}}, {{ill|Tokushima Prefecture|en|Tokushima Prefecture|qid=Q160734|lt=Tokushima Prefecture}}.
